name: Université Côte d'Azur Academic Excellence Scholarship (IdEx)
requiredDocuments: First, an admission application to one of the eligible international MSc programs submitted via the e-candidat portal (https://ecandidat-uca1.univ-cotedazur.fr) — yielding an eCandidat number (applications without an eCandidat number will not be considered)
The IdEx Academic Excellence Scholarship online form (available only when applications reopen in April), with the requested documents uploaded
Academic results / transcripts (candidates are assessed on their provided results)

timeline.deadline: End of May 2026 (Application Period: April to May annually)
timeline.resultsBy: Mid-June 2026 (announced by email, favorable or not)
timeline.notes: As of 2026-06-18 the scholarship page states 'Applications are currently closed.' The IdEx scholarship application window is April–May annually; the underlying MSc admission deadlines vary by program (e.g. MSc Data Science & AI July 4, 2026; most others May 15 – June 26, 2026 per the Applications page). Apply to the MSc first to obtain an eCandidat number, then submit the scholarship form during April–May. Dates reflect the annually-recurring cycle as published for 2026.

benefits: Stipend of €5,000, paid in two installments
Funding is for ONE YEAR ONLY (single academic year, even on 2-year MSc tracks)
10 IdEx scholarships awarded each year to the best MSc candidates
mustKnow: TWO-STEP / order-sensitive: you must apply and be admitted to one of the eligible international MSc programs (and obtain an eCandidat number) BEFORE applying for the IdEx scholarship — applications without an eCandidat number are not considered.
Funding is ONE YEAR ONLY: tuition exemption + a flat €5,000 stipend in two installments. It does not renew, so for a 2-year MSc the second year is unfunded by this award.
Open to candidates of ANY age or nationality (Bangladeshis explicitly eligible); selection is purely on academic excellence — no age limit.
Students who have ALREADY been registered at Université Côte d'Azur are NOT eligible.
Cannot be combined with any other scholarship.
Only 10 scholarships are awarded per year, restricted to a fixed list of ~11 eligible international MSc programs.
Disbursement is conditional on regular class/exam attendance and exemplary conduct throughout the year — misconduct or absenteeism can forfeit the stipend.
The scholarship application form is only live during the April–May window; outside it the page shows 'Applications are Closed'.
Non-EU applicants from Campus France 'Études en France' countries (which includes Bangladesh) may also need to apply through Campus France in parallel with the compulsory e-candidat application.
duration: Scholarship funds 1 year; eligible MSc programs are typically 1–2 years
eligibleNationalities: Open to all nationalities (candidates of any age or nationality may apply); Bangladesh eligible. Excludes applicants already registered at Université Côte d'Azur.
renewalConditions: No renewal — funding is for one year only; disbursement of installments conditional on regular attendance in classes/examinations and exemplary conduct.
